reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26122502 (0x5e5c1e4770c8f64feec76d239b3c55b5afc785bfd5a762fa715ae00a10be1e08), a creation-to-pin authorization/event census recovered exactly two MarketCreators: the former creator emitted no markets during its authorized period, and the current creator registered all 16 current minters. USG, ControlTower and current MarketCreator runtimes match their verified onchain bytecode. All 16 markets were read at this same pin: totalCollateral, collatDecimals and collatOracle.latestAnswer(true) measure $5,121,357.835756121 of protocol-oracle-marked borrower collateral. For each of the four frxUSD Curve pools, the corresponding market mark is attributed by frxUSD balance times stored rate divided by the sum of both pool balances times stored rates. These four contributions total $313,479.810524550, or 6.121029238299012% of the whole marked collateral denominator. All remaining 93.87897076170099% is an explicit unclassified look-through residual; no known-only normalization or assumed basket is used. Both authorized PegKeepers hold exactly 20M prefunded USG and report debt()=0, so these self-token inventories are not external collateral. TotalSupply 43,817,570.730966665 minus that 40M equals 3,817,570.730966665 circulating units; current market debt 3,817,694.296691635 includes unminted interest and a remaining 95.486099911734909 USG debt/supply difference after removing that interest. This measured collateral envelope does not certify financial reconciliation, legal custody, whole-position realization, or the residual's underlying composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete same-block borrower-collateral market census, valued at each deployed market's USD oracle; exact Curve stored-rate proportional frxUSD attribution and measured disjoint residual. Prefunded PegKeeper self-token inventory is separately observed and excluded, not treated as backing.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The measured 93.87897076170099% remaining borrower collateral is identified at its 16-market position inventory but lacks complete underlying tracked-asset/obligor look-through. It remains an explicit insufficient-evidence residual; current economic reconciliation and whole-slice liquidity are not inferred.
